en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Jews and the Christians, and the Polytheists, when they greet upon the man while he is seated, how it is befitting that he replies upon them?’ So heasws said: ‘He should be saying, ‘Alaykum’ (Upon you)’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama’a who has said the following: “Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) about Jewish, Christians and pagans’ greetings to one sitting, how should he respond?
